estimand: One INN per defined annual stock/event population; distribution of main NACE among SMEs.
prerequisites: Historical code hierarchy, annual date rule, multi-code/NACE policy, denominator.
limit: Do not call company counts production or employment shares.

estimand: One annual employee value per legal-entity INN, only observed nonnegative values.
prerequisites: Historical geography, missingness analysis, workplace limitation, category overlap.
limit: No IP imputation to zero; no sum with non-small-business BDPMO totals.

estimand: Separately defined changes in register presence, not births and deaths of all businesses.
prerequisites: Monthly observation calendar, interval endpoints, register eligibility changes, revisions.
limit: Start/end fields alone do not establish genuine economic entry/exit.

estimand: Observed company income with annual deduplication and source financial definition.
prerequisites: Resolve documentation labels, missingness, float precision, geography and overlap.
limit: Income is not local value added, consumer spending or municipal GDP.
